plain.value: How-to pages for staff at Ashgrove House.

pages.title: Office and IT help
pages.body: Start here for desk booking, phones, printing, passwords and travel at Ashgrove House.

pages.title: Booking a desk
pages.body: Book up to two weeks ahead in the desk app. Team days hold the team's own zone; desks not claimed by 10:00 are released.

pages.title: Resetting your password
pages.body: Use the self-service page from any browser. If you are locked out after five tries, ring the service desk on extension 4400.

pages.title: Printing and scanning
pages.body: Tap your pass on any printer to release your jobs. Scans arrive in your own mailbox as PDF files.

pages.title: Travel and hotel bookings
pages.body: Book rail and hotels through the travel portal. First class needs a director's approval in advance.

pages.title: Submitting expenses
pages.body: Photograph each receipt in the expenses app and submit within 30 days. Mileage is paid at the HMRC rate.

pages.title: Setting up a new starter
pages.body: Raise the starter form five working days before day one so the laptop, pass and phone are ready.

pages.title: Transferring a phone call
pages.body: Press transfer, dial the extension and introduce the caller before you hang up.

pages.title: Visitors at Ashgrove House
pages.body: Visitors sign in at reception and wear a badge. Collect them from reception and walk them back; nobody follows you through the barriers.

pages.title: Lost or stolen laptop
pages.body: Ring the service desk straight away so the laptop can be locked. Report a theft to the police and keep the crime number.

pages.title: Recycling and confidential waste
pages.body: Blue bins for paper, grey for general waste and the locked consoles for anything with personal data on it.

pages.title: Workplace adjustments
pages.body: Ask HR about screen readers, adjustable desks or a parking space near the door. Requests are kept confidential.
